neighbours.label: the onset of a change: ' began' / ' started' (also 'set in') where something starts to happen
fire: A few months after the surgery, his knee began to ache whenever the weather turned cold.
Toward the end of the second year, the marriage began to fall apart in small ways.
By late October the pond began freezing over along its shallow northern edge.
Once the factory closed, the young families started leaving the valley one by one.
Halfway through the lecture, the students started to whisper and check their phones.
As the medication wore off, the pain began creeping back into her shoulder.
Within a week of the announcement, customers began cancelling their orders in large numbers.
Late in the afternoon the clouds started to gather over the hills behind the village.
quiet: A few months after the surgery, his knee was examined again by the same specialist.
Toward the end of the second year, the marriage ended quietly in a small courtroom.
By late October the pond lay frozen solid along its shallow northern edge.
Once the factory closed, the young families lived on savings and seasonal work.
Halfway through the lecture, the students wrote down the formula from the board.
As the nurse had promised, the pain stayed away from her shoulder all night.
Within a week of the announcement, customers received a full refund for their orders.
Late in the afternoon the clouds hung low over the hills behind the village.

notes: Card: began x2, beginning, 'set in', and commas after 'if you start ...'. Probes: 'began to leak' 0.57, 'started turning' 0.35, 'start feeling' 0.32, 'set in' 0.24, 'is beginning to' 0.14; same frames with other verbs < 0.07. Weak pole (max 6.3), 33% gate-leak regime.
